# Golden Lady

## Overview

- **Origin:** a big cave down on the shore  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

The Golden Lady has long golden hair that reaches all the way down to her feet. She wears a dress that glitters and glistens as if it were living gold.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Personality

The Golden Lady plays music on a golden harp throughout the entire day. Her harp playing can be heard at any time by those along the shore.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Traits

_Not yet known._

## Abilities

- plays on a golden harp all day long  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

The Golden Lady is a character in an imaginative composition written by Anne's favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Her story and presence are recounted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her experiences with her teaching pupils.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_
